Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

Hair: red-copper-auburn, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: sculpted edge pattern. Wardrobe: asymmetric-patchwork, specifically intentional patchwork layers with an uneven hem, visible repairs, and practical trousers; low-profile toggles and articulated knee folds; bounded palette teal-brown. Maintenance cue: ornate hair maintenance with plain clothing care. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: one thumb hooks lightly beneath the waist wrap while the other hand rests open. Include a wooden thread gauge only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
